=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Issue Goal 4 says "The audit follows `/audit-plans` steps 1–8". For a plan whose name is already taken in `docs/completed/`, step 7 of `.claude/commands/audit-plans.md` (line 54) says: "diff the two: byte-identical → `git rm` the `docs/plans/` copy; different → `git mv -f` so the `docs/plans/` version (the maintained copy) replaces the stale archive copy."
  Expected change site: the Step 7 paragraph in `prompts/mode-plan-audit.txt` and `prompts/_templates/mode-plan-audit.txt`, and `check_diff` in `scripts/plan_autopilot.py` (the archive branches around the status `D` / `A` handling and the `archive_deleted` / `archive_written` pairing loop).
  Evidence of absence:
  - Step 7 of the unattended prompt does the opposite, saying "Never archive a plan when `docs/completed/<name>.md` already exists ... leave that plan in `docs/plans/`".
  - `check_diff` accepts an archive target only as status `A`.
  - In the byte-identical case, the `archive_deleted` entry has no matching `archive_written`, so the pairing loop raises `diff_outside_allowlist` ("archive target does not carry the plan content").
  - In the different case, an `M` of the existing completed file falls to the final `else` and is refused.
  - Both `docs/plans/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md` and `docs/completed/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md` exist.
  - `decide_outcome` still reports COMPLETE (`idle_all_done`), so the plan is audited again every day.
  - The step 4a bullet "archive it unchanged in step 7" does not state the exception.
  - The divergence was chosen deliberately in an earlier round to avoid overwrites.
  - Suggested fix: allow only the byte-identical `D` case, where the old blob equals the HEAD blob at `docs/completed/X.md`, and keep refusing replacement.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING: prompts/mode-plan-audit.txt and prompts/_templates/mode-plan-audit.txt, first bullet of Step 4a (added in the last run)
  issue: "archive it unchanged in step 7" reads as unconditional. Step 7 keeps a COMPLETE plan in `docs/plans/` when it has no `refs_issue` or when `docs/completed/<name>.md` exists. A model that follows the wording literally would make an archive move that `check_diff` refuses. That run ends with `diff_outside_allowlist`, saves no marker, and the 75-minute audit reruns on the next idle tick.
  suggested minimal fix: "archive it unchanged only as step 7 allows", applied in both files so the template still assembles to the prompt byte for byte; estimated lines changed: 2
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

Both `docs/plans/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md` and `docs/completed/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md` exist, so the colliding COMPLETE plan stays unarchived.
